title: wa-review structured output
description: Machine-readable output of the wa-review skill. Emitted as wa-review.json alongside the markdown report so downstream tools (wa-ci baseline diff, wa-portfolio aggregation, WA Tool import) can consume a stable contract instead of parsing prose. Version this file; external tools depend on it.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the document conforms to. This is the v1 contract, so it accepts any 1.x.y: a backward-compatible minor/patch bump (new optional field, widened enum) still validates. Consumers reject on the MAJOR only; wa-ci compares major versions. A breaking change ships as wa-review-v2.schema.json.

workload.description: Human-readable workload name, stable across reviews so a baseline diff can pair a review with its predecessor.

review_mode.description: Which wa-review depth produced this document. Consumers use it to interpret coverage: a pillar-scoped or score run does not evaluate all 307 BPs, so its absence of a finding is not evidence of implementation.

skill_version.description: SKILL.md frontmatter version that generated this document (e.g. 2.2.0). Lets a consumer detect when the producing skill changed between baseline and current.

run_id.description: Opaque identifier unique to this review run. Used to distinguish two reviews of the same workload on the same date when diffing against a baseline.

lens.description: WA lenses applied on top of the core framework (e.g. serverless-applications, financial-services). Empty or omitted for a core-only review.

business_criticality.description: Declared business criticality of the workload. A gate may weight findings by this (e.g. fail only on new High findings in critical workloads).

pillar_scores.description: Maturity score 1-5 per pillar. A pillar-scoped or single-pillar review MAY include only the pillars it evaluated.

findings.description: One entry per best practice evaluated. A full review targets the full 307-BP corpus; other modes carry fewer. Every finding, including Implemented and Not Applicable ones, MAY appear so a consumer can tell an evaluated-and-passed BP from one that was never assessed.

recall_note.description: Honest statement of coverage limits. wa-review measures F1=0.96 (not 1.0), so this output is high-recall but not guaranteed exhaustive. Consumers and gates MUST NOT treat the absence of a finding as proof a control exists. State the measured recall and the review mode's coverage here.

finding.description: One evaluated best practice. MUST carry a bp_id OR a title (see anyOf). Core framework BPs and most lens BPs have a canonical bp_id and are the only findings a baseline diff can pair over time. Some lenses (e.g. serverless-applications, saas, government, healthcare-industry, container-build, sap, streaming-media) are organized by topic and expose no BP IDs; their findings carry a title instead and are reported as advisory, never gated.

allOf.$comment: A gap finding (not_implemented / partially_implemented) MUST carry a non-null severity. A gate ranks by severity, so an unrated gap would silently fail open. Implemented / not_applicable / cannot_determine findings may omit it.

bp_id.description: Canonical best-practice ID in PILLAR##-BP## form (e.g. SEC03-BP02, or a lens-prefixed IOTCOST01-BP01). This is the identity key a baseline diff pairs on. Present for every core-framework BP and every lens BP that publishes an ID. Omit ONLY for findings from a topic-organized lens that exposes no BP ID; those findings MUST carry a title and are advisory (never gated).

title.description: Short human-readable name of the best practice or topic. Required when bp_id is absent (a topic-organized lens finding). Optional context otherwise. Not a stable identity key: a diff does NOT pair on title, so a finding with only a title is reported and counted but never gated.

lens.description: Name of the WA lens this finding comes from (e.g. serverless-applications), matching an entry in the document-level lens array. Omit for a core-framework finding.

pillar.description: Owning pillar. For a lens BP, use the pillar the lens BP maps to.

status.description: Assessment outcome for this BP. cannot_determine means the review could not verify from the available evidence, distinct from a confirmed gap.

severity.description: Risk severity for a gap (Impact x Likelihood). Null or omitted for implemented / not_applicable BPs.

evidence.description: Where in the workload this was observed. Omit when the review was verbal and no code was analyzed.

effort.description: Estimated remediation effort, feeding Eisenhower prioritization downstream.

recommendation.description: Concise remediation guidance. Never a code diff, consistent with the repo's review-and-guidance-not-code-mutation principle.

file.description: Repo-relative path where the evidence was found.

note.description: Free-text evidence when no precise file:line applies (e.g. 'Based on description, verify in code').
